name: Cross-venue lead-lag: follower quoting and price-discovery signals
one_line: Use Kalshi, the US book, sharp books, Binance or options as a fair-value input for Polymarket-only quoting or selective taking; no capital on the leader venue.
maturity: Emerging: lags measured, profit not; one systematic attempt failed out of sample
requires_ai: optional: pair matching and news relevance
edge: Deeper or faster venues reprice first; Polymarket makers price only their own book
opportunity_size: lags 2-3 s sports (self-reported), 347 ms crypto; pre-game NFL already equal across venues
expected_results: no public data; maker overlay may cut markout losses 10-30% (guess)
competition: institutional makers link books; crypto makers react in ~350 ms
flag: none; grey commercial use of Polymarket US data
validate: 2-week synchronised recording of 30-50 pairs; pass t>2 follower PnL or 15% markout reduction
top_risk: Taker delay makes stale-quote picking adverse; leader flips
solo_fit_reason: Free data, single-venue capital and direct reuse inside any quoting engine; weak as a standalone taker strategy but cheap to test and compounding with 02/04/05.
speed_class: latency-sensitive: seconds (sports) to hundreds of ms (crypto)
capacity_ceiling: ~$25k-50k: lag persists only in thin Polymarket markets
changes_made: Live: US book half-cent ticks vs intl 1c; three venues equal on NFL pre-game.
Added OpenMarket null result as the counterweight.
open_doubts: 2024 lead-lag paper read at abstract level.
